extraction: loop-design-check identifies 5 failure modes for agent loops: (1) Token burn — loop spins without progress; (2) Goodhart gaming — verifier hacked, not quality; (3) Wrong answer to completion — decidable goal not met; (4) Boundary escape — loop accesses unauthorized resources; (5) Judge dependence — human judgment not kept. Maps to our 18-lang OCR goal: Engine loop building Phase 6 engines must have machine-decidable goal (CER delta on 18 langs), not 'looks better'.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: whether every Engine build loop passes loop-design-check review before execution
transfer_harness_fact: 18 Indic langs, weak cells, 200-dpi citizen docs, no paid keys, no training until W6 freeze, offline pipeline
